omopColumns.name: nhs_number

dataSource.name: patient_identifier_value
dataSource.description: Patient NHS number, used to join existing OMOP Person records.

omopColumns.query:
select
    patient_identifier_value,
    clinical_date,
    clinical_datetime,
    clinical_code,
    replace(upper(trim(clinical_code)), '.', '') as concept_code
from ##duckdb_source##
where upper(trim(clinical_code_system)) = 'OPCS4'

omopColumns.name: observation_concept_id
omopColumns.operation_description: Maps concepts to standard valid concepts in the `Observation` domain.
